# Using mdgrid

View and edit Markdown notes with frontmatter as a table in the terminal. The screens show the tasks of the sample web studio (examples/studio/Tasks) and the sample of awkward notes (examples/quirks).

<!-- generated by app-manual/tui_shot.py: the screenshot gallery. The manual's chapters link to images/. -->

## Open a folder

![Open a folder](images/table.svg)

Notes become rows and frontmatter keys become columns. The search bar is on top; the keys you can press now are at the bottom.

## Pick a value

Keys: `Enter`

![Pick a value](images/edit-list.svg)

Press Enter on a status cell. Choose from the values other notes use, or just type a new one.

## Type to narrow the candidates

Keys: `Enter` `d` `o`

![Type to narrow the candidates](images/list-narrow.svg)

Typing in the list keeps only the candidates that contain what you typed (nothing is selected yet). Pick one with Down or Up, or press Enter to write what you typed.

## Enter a date with the calendar

Keys: `l` `l` `l` `Enter`

![Enter a date with the calendar](images/edit-date.svg)

Date columns open a calendar. Move with the arrow keys and press Enter.

## Add and remove tags

Keys: `l` `l` `l` `l` `l` `l` `l` `Enter`

![Add and remove tags](images/edit-tags.svg)

List columns let you toggle values found across the root folder.

## Review the diff, then save

Keys: `Enter` `Down` `Enter` `C-s`

![Review the diff, then save](images/save.svg)

Edits are kept until you save. Ctrl+S shows the diff per file; confirm to write. Nothing outside the edited value changes.

## After saving

Keys: `Enter` `Down` `Enter` `C-s` `Enter`

![After saving](images/save-done.svg)

Press Enter in the save review to write. Unsaved goes back to 0 and the number of files written is shown.

## Help

Keys: `?`

![Help](images/help.svg)

? lists every key. Keys can be rebound in the config (docs/keys.md).

## Command palette

Keys: `:`

![Command palette](images/palette.svg)

Press : to find an action by name.

## View settings

Keys: `o`

![View settings](images/view-settings.svg)

Press o to choose columns, filters, sorting and grouping, and save them as a mdgrid view.

## Create a note

Keys: `a`

![Create a note](images/new-note.svg)

Press a, or click "+ New" at the right end of the view bar: the new note form lists the name and a field for each column, and preset values show where they come from.

## The new note

Keys: `a` `text:Call Rosa about the menu` `C-s`

![The new note](images/new-note-done.svg)

Type a name and press Ctrl+S: the file is created at once (Enter moves to the next field), and its row is selected.

## Find a command by name

Keys: `:` `text:save`

![Find a command by name](images/palette-search.svg)

Type part of a name; each command shows its key next to it.

## Actions for the selected cell

Keys: `x`

![Actions for the selected cell](images/action-menu.svg)

x or a right click lists what you can do on the selected cell, grouped by cell, column, row, and view and file, each with its key. Pick one with ↑↓ and Enter, or press its key; Esc closes.

## Keys that follow a prefix

Keys: `g`

![Keys that follow a prefix](images/prefix-hint.svg)

After a prefix key such as g, the bottom band lists the keys you can press next. Esc cancels the prefix.

## Open a .base file

![Open a .base file](images/base-tabs.svg)

Each table view of the .base becomes a tab; the first one opens. Column titles come from displayName.

## Switch views; grouped rows

Keys: `]` `]`

![Switch views; grouped rows](images/base-group.svg)

] and [ switch views. This view groups the tasks by status with heading rows.

## Fold a group

Keys: `]` `]` `Enter`

![Fold a group](images/base-group-folded.svg)

Enter on a heading row folds or unfolds its group.

## Formulas mdgrid cannot evaluate

Keys: `l`

![Formulas mdgrid cannot evaluate](images/base-unsupported-formula.svg)

A column whose formula is not supported shows a dim ? instead of guessing. Select it to see which expression.

## Views other than table

![Views other than table](images/base-cards.svg)

Only table views are supported; other view types are not opened and the reason is shown.

## Sync conflict files

Keys: `:` `text:3` `Enter`

![Sync conflict files](images/sync-conflict.svg)

Conflict copies made by sync tools are marked with ! so you can resolve them by hand.

## Empty, null, missing and mismatched values

Keys: `j` `j` `j` `j` `j` `j` `j` `j` `j` `l` `l`

![Empty, null, missing and mismatched values](images/cell-marks.svg)

∅ is null, "" is an empty string, a blank cell has no key, and ! marks a value that does not fit the column type (someday in a date column). The notes are from examples/quirks.

## Details of one note

Keys: `K`

![Details of one note](images/detail.svg)

K lists every property of the note; long values wrap in full. Enter edits the selected one.

## Without colors

Keys: `Backspace`

![Without colors](images/no-color.svg)

With NO_COLOR or --no-color, pending changes and other states are still shown by marks such as *.

## Go to a row number

Keys: `:` `text:14`

![Go to a row number](images/goto-line.svg)

Type a number in the palette and press Enter to jump to that row.

## Search

Keys: `/` `text:doing` `Enter`

![Search](images/search.svg)

/ highlights every match; n and N move between them. Lowercase terms ignore case.

## Quick filter

Keys: `\` `text:bakery`

![Quick filter](images/quick-filter.svg)

\ moves into the search bar; rows narrow as you type, and the bar shows the count. Esc clears it.

## Only rows with the same value

Keys: `,`

![Only rows with the same value](images/filter-same.svg)

, keeps the rows whose value equals the selected cell; * only highlights them.

## Sort by a column

Keys: `l` `l` `l` `s`

![Sort by a column](images/sort-column.svg)

s sorts by the column: ascending, descending, then off. The view remembers it; the .base file is not changed.

## Hide a column

Keys: `l` `-`

![Hide a column](images/hide-column.svg)

- hides the column and + brings it back. H and L move columns; < and > change the width.

## Add a column

Keys: `A` `r` `e` `v` `i` `e` `w` `e` `r` `Enter`

![Add a column](images/add-column.svg)

A adds a column for a key no note has yet. Only the notes you fill in get the key when you save.

## Set the time of a date and time

Keys: `Enter` `C-o` `Up`

![Set the time of a date and time](images/edit-datetime-time.svg)

Date and time columns show a time field under the calendar. Ctrl+O switches to it; Up and Down move 15 minutes, Shift+Up and Shift+Down one hour.

## Export the table to a file

Keys: `:` `text:export_table` `Enter` `text:tasks.csv` `Enter`

![Export the table to a file](images/export-table.svg)

The command palette exports the table as shown (filters, sorting and hidden columns applied). The extension picks the format: .csv, .tsv, .json or .md. The first column is each note's path, so a CSV or JSON can come back with --apply.

## Open a registered table

Keys: `:` `text:open_place` `Enter`

![Open a registered table](images/open-place.svg)

Tables registered in places.toml (from the palette's register this table, or by hand) are listed by group. Type to narrow, Enter to open. Plain mdgrid with no arguments shows the same list.

## Freeze columns

Keys: `l` `F` `End`

![Freeze columns](images/freeze-columns.svg)

F keeps the columns up to the selected one visible while you scroll right.

## Mark rows

Keys: `Space` `Space` `Space`

![Mark rows](images/mark-rows.svg)

Space marks a row and moves down; v selects a range, Ctrl+A selects all, Esc clears.

## Type a new value

Keys: `Enter` `text:waiting`

![Type a new value](images/edit-free-text.svg)

Typing in the list replaces the value with what you type (← or Backspace first to edit the current value instead). Enter confirms, Esc cancels, Tab confirms and moves right.

## Toggle a checkbox

Keys: `l` `l` `l` `l` `l` `l` `Enter`

![Toggle a checkbox](images/checkbox-toggle.svg)

Enter switches between true and false (an empty cell becomes true; Backspace empties it). The change is pending until you save.

## Dates are checked

Keys: `l` `l` `l` `Enter` `Backspace` `Backspace` `Backspace` `Backspace` `Backspace` `Backspace` `Backspace` `Backspace` `Backspace` `Backspace` `text:2026-02-30` `Enter`

![Dates are checked](images/edit-date-invalid.svg)

A date that does not exist is refused and the input stays open. +3 means three days from today.

## Numbers only in number columns

Keys: `l` `l` `l` `l` `Enter` `text:a` `Enter`

![Numbers only in number columns](images/edit-number-invalid.svg)

A number column accepts only values that read as a number.

## Empty a cell

Keys: `Backspace`

![Empty a cell](images/clear-cell.svg)

Backspace or Delete empties the value; it is saved as `key:` and the key stays.

## A value of the wrong type

Keys: `j` `j` `j` `j` `j` `j` `j` `j` `j` `l` `l` `Enter`

![A value of the wrong type](images/type-mismatch.svg)

A cell whose value does not fit the column opens the input for the column's type, showing this month.

## Set a value on several rows

Keys: `Space` `Space` `Space` `k` `Enter`

![Set a value on several rows](images/bulk-set.svg)

With rows marked, the edit applies to all of them. Rows that cannot take the value are skipped and counted.

## Add or remove list items on several rows

Keys: `l` `l` `l` `l` `l` `l` `l` `Space` `Space` `Space` `k` `Enter`

![Add or remove list items on several rows](images/bulk-tags.svg)

[x] means every marked row has the item, [-] some of them. Other items in each row are kept.

## Edited rows stay in place

Keys: `Enter` `text:done` `Enter`

![Edited rows stay in place](images/held-row.svg)

This view hides finished tasks; a row you change to done stays until you save or move, so it does not vanish.

## Notes without frontmatter

Keys: `G` `k` `Enter` `text:todo` `Enter` `C-s`

![Notes without frontmatter](images/add-frontmatter.svg)

Writing to a note without frontmatter adds a --- block at the top; the body is unchanged.

## Cells you cannot edit

Keys: `j` `j` `l` `l` `l` `l` `l` `l` `l` `Enter`

![Cells you cannot edit](images/readonly-cell-nested.svg)

Nested maps, block scalars, file.* and formula.* columns and a few other forms are read-only; Enter shows the reason.

## Values with line breaks

Keys: `G` `End` `Enter`

![Values with line breaks](images/multiline-value.svg)

Values with line breaks cannot be edited in the one-line input; open the note with e.

## Date format and week start from the config

Keys: `l` `l` `l` `Enter`

![Date format and week start from the config](images/showcase-calendar.svg)

examples/configs/studio.toml sets date_format = "YYYY/MM/DD (ddd)" and week_start = "mon". Notes still get YYYY-MM-DD.

## Quitting with unsaved changes

Keys: `Backspace` `q`

![Quitting with unsaved changes](images/quit-confirm.svg)

s reviews and saves, d discards and quits, Esc goes back.

## Open read-only

Keys: `Enter`

![Open read-only](images/readonly-mode.svg)

--readonly never writes: no editing, no saving, no new notes, and view settings are not remembered.

## Filter by picking values

Keys: `o` `Enter` `Enter` `Enter` `Down` `Down` `Down` `Space`

![Filter by picking values](images/view-filter-values.svg)

Choose a column, then tick the values to keep or hide. Counts are shown; (empty) covers notes without the key.

## The settings band

Keys: `o` `Enter` `Enter` `Enter` `Down` `Down` `Down` `Space` `Enter` `Tab` `Tab` `Tab` `Tab` `Tab` `Tab` `Tab` `Enter` `f`

![The settings band](images/chips.svg)

Active filters, sorting and grouping appear above the table. f moves into the band; Backspace removes an item.

## Row numbers and column lines

Keys: `o` `Tab` `Tab` `Tab` `Tab` `Space` `Down` `Down` `Space` `Tab` `Tab` `Tab` `Enter`

![Row numbers and column lines](images/display-row-numbers.svg)

The Display section turns on row numbers, zebra stripes and column lines for this view.

## Save as an mdgrid view

Keys: `o` `Tab` `Tab` `Tab` `Tab` `Tab` `Tab` `Tab` `Down` `Down` `Down` `Enter` `text:mine` `Enter`

![Save as an mdgrid view](images/native-view-save.svg)

Save the current settings under a name; it becomes a tab next to Default table and is kept in views.toml.

## Export to a new .base

Keys: `:` `text:export_base` `Enter`

![Export to a new .base](images/export-base.svg)

Writes the view to a new .base under a name you choose; existing .base files are never overwritten.

## Import a .base view

Keys: `:` `text:import_base` `Enter`

![Import a .base view](images/import-base.svg)

Pick a .base and one of its views to copy it as an mdgrid view.

## Imported view

Keys: `:` `text:import_base` `Enter` `Enter` `Enter`

![Imported view](images/import-base-done.svg)

The view becomes a tab. Parts an mdgrid view cannot hold (formulas, limit, displayName) are listed as dropped.

## New note in a filtered view

Keys: `a`

![New note in a filtered view](images/new-note-base.svg)

In a view filtered by status == "doing", the new note gets status: doing so it stays in the view.

## Choose where to create it

Keys: `a`

![Choose where to create it](images/new-note-place.svg)

With two or more folders open, you first pick the folder; the first one is selected.

## Pick rows for another command

Keys: `Space` `Space`

![Pick rows for another command](images/pick.svg)

--pick opens the table read-only; Enter prints the marked rows' paths, one per line, and exits. q cancels.

## The sample configuration

![The sample configuration](images/showcase-table.svg)

examples/configs/studio.toml changes the date format, adds column lines, zebra rows, rules and value colors, and rebinds Ctrl+F to search. Start it with --config.

## A read-only note

Keys: `G` `Enter`

![A read-only note](images/readonly-row.svg)

A note mdgrid cannot write safely (here a duplicate key) is shown but read-only, with the reason.

## A .base view of a task list

![A .base view of a task list](images/demo-table.svg)

examples/studio/Tasks.base: seven table views as tabs. The Open view hides finished tasks and sorts by due date; project and owner are links shown by name. The row under the table sums the estimates and shows the earliest due date.

## Pick a status

Keys: `Enter`

![Pick a status](images/demo-edit-list.svg)

Enter on a status cell lists the values other notes use.

## Pick a due date

Keys: `l` `l` `l` `Enter`

![Pick a due date](images/demo-calendar.svg)

Date columns open a calendar.

## Review the diff, then save

Keys: `Enter` `Up` `Enter` `C-s`

![Review the diff, then save](images/demo-save.svg)

Ctrl+S shows exactly which bytes will change in each file.

## Grouped by status

Keys: `]` `]`

![Grouped by status](images/demo-group.svg)

The By status view groups rows under headings you can fold with Enter.

## Human and AI tasks

![Human and AI tasks](images/demo-ai-human.svg)

The ai-human sample groups open tasks by a formula: the ones that need a person on top, the ones an AI agent can finish below.

## Actions for the selected cell

Keys: `x`

![Actions for the selected cell](images/demo-menu.svg)

x or a right click lists what you can do here, each with its key.

## The Nord theme

![The Nord theme](images/demo-theme.svg)

[look] theme = "nord" in the config. Seven themes are built in.

## Relation map

Keys: `R`

![Relation map](images/demo-relmap.svg)

R draws the tables of the workspace as boxes, with an arrow from each link column to the table it points at: tasks to projects and people, projects to clients, meetings to projects and people.

## Count the values of a column

Keys: `%`

![Count the values of a column](images/demo-freq.svg)

% lists each value of the column with its count and share; Enter keeps only those rows.

## The tree screen

Keys: `T` `j` `j` `j`

![The tree screen](images/tree.svg)

T, on a table whose workspace marker has a tree setting. The left pane is the folder tree built from the folder column, with a count per folder; the right pane lists the rows of the selected folder. Enter folds or opens a folder, Esc goes back to the table.

## Create a ledger from a starter

Keys: `:` `text:starter` `Enter`

![Create a ledger from a starter](images/starter-pick.svg)

The command palette's "Create a ledger from a starter" lists the built-in starters (tasks, bookmarks, reading, people) and your own. Pick one, choose the folder, say whether to include the samples, and the new table opens.

## The tasks starter

![The tasks starter](images/starter-tasks.svg)

examples/tasks was made with `--init-workspace --starter tasks --with-samples`: one note per task, tabs by status (Open, Doing, Waiting, Done), due date, priority and tags.

## The reading starter

![The reading starter](images/starter-reading.svg)

examples/reading was made with the reading starter: books, articles, films and talks, with the tabs Queue, Now and Done, and columns for kind, author and rating.

## The people starter: relation map

Keys: `R`

![The people starter: relation map](images/starter-people.svg)

examples/people was made with the people starter: a People table (role, organization, contact) and a Meetings table (date, attendees, next actions) linked to it. R shows the two tables and the links between them.

## The gantt screen

Keys: `C`

![The gantt screen](images/gantt.svg)

C on a table with a gantt setting (or date columns named like start and due): the rows of the current view as bars from the start date to the due date, with today marked. + and - switch the unit between day, week and month.
